description: Collect TikTok's ranked trending hashtags and trending videos by market, time window and industry, with post/view counts, popularity curves, momentum signals, creator leaders and video engagement metrics. No login, cookies or proxy setup.

countries.description: (mode=trendingHashtags) One or more markets to read the hashtag chart for. Each market adds its own ranked rows.
countries.title: Markets

includeCreatorLeaders.description: (mode=trendingHashtags) Add creator rows that aggregate the creators TikTok credits across the collected hashtags, sorted by how many trends they appear in.
includeCreatorLeaders.title: Add Creator Leaderboard

includeOverallRanking.description: (mode=trendingHashtags) Include each market's overall top-3 hashtag chart. Turn off to read only the industry charts selected below.
includeOverallRanking.title: Include Overall Chart

includeTopComments.description: (mode=trendingVideos) Add each video's top comments and comment keywords. Each video's comments are read separately (up to 100 videos per run).
includeTopComments.title: Include Top Comments

industries.description: (mode=trendingHashtags) Specific industry charts to read when 'Scan all industries' is off. Ignored when scanning all industries. 19 public categories are available.
industries.title: Industry Charts

maxItems.description: Maximum number of data rows to write per run. Creator rows are not counted.
maxItems.title: Maximum Rows

minHashtagAppearances.description: (mode=trendingHashtags, creator leaderboard only) Only list creators credited on at least this many collected hashtag rows.
minHashtagAppearances.title: Minimum Trend Appearances

mode.description: Choose 'Trending hashtags' for TikTok's ranked hashtag charts (post/view counts, popularity curve, creators) or 'Trending videos' for TikTok's ranked video charts (views, engagement, author stats).
mode.title: What to collect

periods.description: (mode=trendingHashtags) Lookback windows in days. 7 shows recent spikes, 90 shows longer-term trends. Select one or more.
periods.title: Time Windows

scanAllIndustries.description: (mode=trendingHashtags) Read all 19 industry charts for every market and window. This widens coverage from 3 to up to 60 hashtags per market and window, because each industry chart is read separately.
scanAllIndustries.title: Scan All Industries

videoContentTags.description: (mode=trendingVideos) Query TikTok's video ranking by content tag and dedupe the videos. Each selected tag is a separate ranking read; 'All tags' also includes the unfiltered chart, returning up to ~24 videos per market, window and sort instead of 4. Leave empty for the current unfiltered ranking.
videoContentTags.title: Video Content Tags

videoCountries.description: (mode=trendingVideos) Markets with a public TikTok trending-video chart. Select one or more.
videoCountries.title: Video Markets

videoOrganicOnly.description: (mode=trendingVideos) Rank only organic (non-promoted) videos. TikTok returns a different ranking for organic-only charts.
videoOrganicOnly.title: Organic Videos Only

videoPeriods.description: (mode=trendingVideos) Windows in days for the trending-video chart: 7 for videos created in the last week, 30 for the last month.
videoPeriods.title: Video Time Windows

videoSortBy.description: (mode=trendingVideos) Metric used for the video ranking.
videoSortBy.title: Rank Videos By

weeksBack.description: (mode=trendingVideos) Add past weekly rankings by moving the chart end date back 7 days per step (0-4). Useful for comparing this week with earlier weeks.
weeksBack.title: Extra Weekly Windows

title: TikTok Hashtag Momentum & Top Creator Tracker Input
